blocks.text: A clubhouse, exercise room and bike room.
17 Avenue is close to Semiahmoo Town Centre and the shops on 152 Street, a short drive to White Rock beach. Short-term rentals are not allowed, per the strata record.

items.t: the Form B, two years of minutes, the bylaws, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show what HALVÖ owners are planning to fix and pay for.
since November 24, 2022, BC stratas cannot ban owners from renting, except in age-restricted buildings. Short-term rental limits can still apply.
pet limits, parking stalls, storage lockers and electric car charging are set by the bylaws and the title, home by home. Check them for the exact home you are buying.
